name: jev-chat-review
description: Monitor open Codex chats locally and optionally review completed turns with Jev.

interface.shortDescription: Multi-chat Codex monitor with Jev model-fit advice.
interface.longDescription: Open Codex chats can be monitored locally for current or completed turn duration, repeated identical tool actions/results, and latest token/context usage. At turn end, optional Jev review weighs the bounded visible transcript and local usage evidence to advise whether to keep the current model, try a more capable or faster model, or stay uncertain. Advice is confidence-rated and never changes your model. Monitoring stores only derived signals and makes no AI/API calls. Optional Jev review requires your AI Gateway key; chat data is sent to the provider and may incur charges.
interface.defaultPrompt: Show me my open Codex chats, turn durations, and repeated-action warnings.
